objective: Validate bit-exact special-value propagation through the candidate.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture output bits.
pass_condition: Pass iff each output bit pattern equals the source bit pattern at its floor-mod coordinate exactly.
setup: Fill source with alternating bit patterns 0x7fc12345, 0xffc00001, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x00000000, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, 0x007fffff; use width=16, height=16, pitch=16, shiftX=3, shiftY=5; compute host oracle on bit patterns.
